historicalEvidence.finding: Fixtures manually construct the missing Boolean while naming pelora-current-convergence-v1. They prove expected consumer shape, not producer output or a translator.

governance.featureAssociation: buildGovernedOceanSignalFeatureAssociationV1 explicitly forbids inferring current-supported-transition -> currentConvergence; explicit provenance identity is required. It is downstream and does not populate the Boolean.

governance.quality: Producer requires finite coverage, not confidence, persistence or a freshness cutoff. Stale candidate remains candidate. Partial coverage removes evaluability. No separate arbitrary quality score accepted/injected.

downstream.directScoreGateRanking: No direct scoring/gate/ranking read of the nested Boolean found. Other similarly named evidence/relationship fields are distinct contracts. This review does not infer transitive scoring equivalence or score improvement.
